name: 911 SSPO Invoicing Prep
description: Splits a pricing sheet into one workbook per Batch + Nest ('BATCH NEST Pricing Back Up.xlsx', each in its own 'BATCH NEST Invoicing Docs' folder) with an Invoice Supplement tab (PO/Line from the Working Forecast List), plus a top-level 'D911 Workorder Close Outs' sheet (cols A-Machine, Scheduling Group set to Closed).
author: Anthony Sieben

fields.label: Forecast and Inventory Reports Directory
fields.description: Path to the 'Forecast and Inventory Reports' folder containing 'Working Forecast List.xlsx' (used to look up PO / PO Line per nest). Leave blank to use the default OneDrive path.
fields.placeholder: C:\Users\YourName\American Steel & Alum\Communication site - Electric Boat ASA Docs\Pilot Program\Forecast and Inventory Reports

fields.label: Working Forecast Filename
fields.description: Name of the forecast workbook inside the Forecast and Inventory Reports folder.
